data.body: **[P1] Escape unframed forwarded errors before recording payload provenance.** When a standard invoke fails inside a child/map/parallel context and its external `errorData` starts with `@aws-durable-payload:`, this branch leaves the text unchanged when offloading is disabled. The child can then attach itself as the payload source, causing the next forwarding/root boundary to decode external data and replace the expected operation failure with `PayloadOffloadException`. Use `serializePreEncodedPayload` here to wrap reserved-marker data in a child-owned inline envelope, and add a nested standard-invoke regression test.
